title: Regal PvP Pack
description: this texture pack adds features and textures on all items in the game, mainly inspired by the color green.
body:
this texture pack is mainly inspired by the color green, it modifies armor and most of the PvP items.

here's what the texture pack changes:


armor(all types)

sword(all types except copper)

diamond axe

enchanted and normal golden apple

apple

hud

hearts

hunger

the inventory

fire

and some blocks.
